sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP asks Google Play to license the app at startup and sends unlicensed installs to a Play Store block page. Disables that check at its entry point so the patched app can open.
Turns on Lifetime permanently: every premium feature unlocks as if the one-time Lifetime purchase (Mobile + Web) were bought, and stays on across restarts.

Stops the app reporting usage: AppsFlyer and the TikTok Business SDK never initialize, Skylum's own stats sender (stats-api.skylum.com) is disabled, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance collection is turned off, and Sentry is removed…
